# Codex code-color reference

The semantic color adapter and its independent color fixtures follow
`openai/codex` revision
`079e17a422347e49d02501304f79fade7e569362` (2026-11-03 local checkout):

- `codex-rs/tui/src/render/highlight.rs`: Catppuccin Mocha/Latte, scope colors,
  language aliases, bold-only syntax attributes, and highlighting limits.
- `codex-rs/tui/src/markdown_render.rs`: heading/emphasis attributes, inline
  code, links, list markers, quotes, and unframed fenced code in `render.rs`.
- `codex-rs/tui/src/diff_render.rs`: default added/removed backgrounds.
- `codex-rs/tui/src/exec_cell/render.rs`: Bash highlighting for displayed commands.
- `codex-rs/tui/src/color.rs` and `style/contrast.rs`: color distance, blending,
  contrast threshold and bounded foreground cache. Adaptations live in scode's
  `render/color_math.rs`; `render/color_theme.rs` owns semantic roles, syntax
  scope selection, terminal styles and contrast on painted surfaces.

These adapters originally followed `b741e480e203f037ca726bc2a76d99a8e8668e66`
(2026-10-03). The newer reference includes themed Markdown headings and
emphasis. UI/count emphasis remains separate from prose emphasis, and scode's
brand role retains amber rather than using an upstream markup color.

The adjacent Apache-2.0 license and upstream notice accompany these adaptations.
Scode uses its existing inline renderer, without a Ratatui dependency.

File preview line numbers, adaptive table column allocation and key/value
fallback additionally follow `openai/codex` revision
`970111f6cb` (2026-10-27 local checkout). The table algorithms are adapted from
`tui/src/markdown_render.rs` and `markdown_render/table_key_value.rs` into
`render/table.rs`, using scode's shared StyledText for styles and hyperlinks.
Terminal-cell correction for halfwidth sound marks from `tui/src/width.rs`
lives in the shared `render/text_layout.rs` width contract.
Grapheme projection and source-range recovery from `tui/src/wrapping.rs` live
in `render/word_wrap.rs`; textwrap 0.16.2 uses the same FirstFit, Unicode and
hyphen-breaking options, without the unused optimal-fit dependency.
`tests/fixtures/codex_tables.json` copies upstream committed plain-text
snapshots and their Markdown inputs; real PTYs compare the CLI's actual rows.
Append-only open-fence previews follow `render/highlight_streaming.rs`, while
retaining scode's bounded live region and final native-scrollback handoff.

`tests/fixtures/codex_default_colors.json` in the CLI crate was generated by
running the original Codex highlighter and contrast resolver in a temporary
reference executable, using two-face 0.5.1 and syntect 5.3.0. The executable
selected each bundled default theme and serialized source text, foregrounds,
and bold flags; contrast samples used the default diff fills. Only terminal
palette plumbing was stubbed for the truecolor samples. PTY assertions compare
actual rendered terminal cells against this independently generated fixture.

`tests/fixtures/codex_styles.json` also covers Markdown roles and indexed
terminal colors. Regenerate it from the pinned local Codex checkout with
`python3 e2e/codex-style/capture.py --codex <checkout> --work-dir <scratch-dir>
--output rust/crates/rusty-sudocode-cli/tests/fixtures/codex_styles.json
--refresh-code-fixtures` to refresh all three color fixtures.
The scratch executable compiles the original style/highlighting helpers;
it is separate from scode's dependency graph. Source is read from the committed
upstream revision, and each fixture records that revision and the helper digest.

`tests/fixtures/codex_bash_colors.json` was generated by the same original
highlighter for single-line and multiline Bash commands. PTYs compare running
command previews and completed scrollback, including multiline string spans.
